question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Fear of water
solution: The correct answer is "**Hydrophobia**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Claustrophobia: **extreme or irrational fear of confined places. • **Hydrophobia:** ** **extreme or irrational fear of water, especially as a symptom of rabies in humans. • **Xenophobia: **dislike of or prejudice against people from other countries. • **Acrophobia:** ** **extreme or irrational fear of heights. • As per the meaning of the given words, **"Hydrophobia"** is the one-word substitute for the given group of words. Hence, the correct answer is option 2. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] Hinglish__** • Let's look at the meaning of the given words. • **Claustrophobia: ** सीमित स्थानों का अत्यधिक या तर्कहीन भय। • **Hydrophobia:**** ** पानी का अत्यधिक या तर्कहीन भय, विशेष रूप से मनुष्यों में रेबीज के लक्षण के रूप में। • **Xenophobia: ** अन्य देशों के लोगों के प्रति नापसंद या पूर्वाग्रह। • **Acrophobia: **ऊंचाई का अत्यधिक या तर्कहीन भय। • As per the meaning of the given words, **"Hydrophobia"** is the one-word substitute for the given group of words. 8b:T4ff, The correct answer is "**to consult him**"
